import argparse
import sys
from decimal import ROUND_HALF_UP, Decimal

from .report import _in_month, _parse_month, find_duplicates, summarize
from .store import load


def _report(path, month):
    transactions = load(path)
    totals = summarize(transactions, month)
    # Largest total first; ties broken by category name A-Z.
    ordered = sorted(totals.items(), key=lambda item: (-Decimal(str(item[1])), item[0]))
    lines = [
        f"{category}: {Decimal(str(total)).quantize(Decimal('0.01'), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP):.2f}"
        for category, total in ordered
    ]

    year, mon = _parse_month(month)
    month_txns = [t for t in transactions if _in_month(t, year, mon)]
    lines.append(f"Possible duplicates: {len(find_duplicates(month_txns))}")
    return "\n".join(lines)


def main(argv=None):
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="ledger")
    sub = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)

    rep = sub.add_parser("report", help="print a monthly report")
    rep.add_argument("path", help="path to the transactions JSON file")
    rep.add_argument("--month", required=True, help="month as YYYY-MM")

    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    if args.command == "report":
        print(_report(args.path, args.month))
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

        T("c", "2026-09-30", category="Food", amount=100),
        T("d", "2026-11-01", category="Food", amount=100),
    ]
    assert summarize(txns, "2026-10") == {"Food": 15.10}


def test_summarize_drops_zero_net_categories():
    txns = [
        T("a", "2026-10-01", category="Fun", amount=18.5),
        T("b", "2026-10-02", category="Fun", amount=-18.5),
    ]
    assert summarize(txns, "2026-10") == {}


def test_summarize_float_noise_does_not_leave_zero_category():
    txns = [
        T("a", "2026-10-01", category="X", amount=0.1),
        T("b", "2026-10-02", category="X", amount=0.2),
        T("c", "2026-10-03", category="X", amount=-0.3),
    ]
    assert summarize(txns, "2026-10") == {}


def test_summarize_rounds_to_two_decimals():
    txns = [T("a", "2026-10-01", category="X", amount=0.1), T("b", "2026-10-02", category="X", amount=0.2)]
